title: relay_queue dead-letter depth scan on every drain tick
description: drain_once does a full read_dir of dead/ on every invocation to count .env files for the dead-letter metric (lines 269-277). For a busy queue with a large dead/ directory this is an O(dead_count) syscall on every retry_interval tick. Should maintain the dead-letter count as an AtomicU64 incremented on each dead-letter write, same as the relay_queue_depth metric is currently set from the live count. Expected impact at scale: hundreds of dead-letter files x 60-second tick interval = ~6 stat syscalls/second, not catastrophic but wasteful.
